summary: Two small corrections: the manuscript's inscription reads 'in Memory of a Summer Day', not 'a Summer's Day', and Alice eats the Eat Me cake at the end of chapter one, not the start of chapter two. Everything else checked out.

changes.before: inscribed 'A Christmas Gift to a Dear Child in Memory of a Summer's Day'
changes.after: inscribed 'A Christmas Gift to a Dear Child in Memory of a Summer Day'
changes.why: The British Library's catalogue record and the transcription of the manuscript both give 'a Summer Day'. The British Library blog listed as a source has the slip.

changes.before: At the start of chapter two, Alice eats a cake
changes.after: At the end of chapter one, Alice eats a cake
changes.why: Alice finds and eats the Eat Me cake at the close of chapter one; 'Curiouser and curiouser!' opens chapter two.

notes: The 'cupboards and bookshelves' quotation follows the modernised Standard Ebooks spelling; the 1865 text prints 'book-shelves'. Left as is.
The British Library blog in the sources gives the inscription as 'a Summer's Day'. It still supports the boat trip, so I kept it.
Details about the app itself (the 7am reminder, the icon) aren't checkable against outside sources and weren't counted.

history.summary: Published before the fact-checker existed. Waiting for its first check.
